entities.summary:
Titus Statilius Taurus was a prominent Roman senator and two-time consul, prominent during the Triumviral and Augustan periods. He was the first known and most important of the line of Roman senators bearing his name.

    The line of Titus Statilius Taurus was a significant element in the Roman senatorial class, producing notable figures in Roman politics and military leadership. The Statilius family played a notable role in the early Roman Empire, with several members serving as consuls and prominent senators.

    The legacy of Titus Statilius Taurus and his descendants can be seen in the Roman Empire's governance, military tactics, and cultural achievements. His descendants played a notable role in shaping the Roman Empire's politics and society, leaving a lasting impact on Western history.

    The story of Titus Statilius Taurus serves as a testament to the enduring legacy of ancient Rome, a civilization that continues to shape our modern world.
